files.content:
---
import { cn } from "@/utils/cn";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types";

export interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<"button"> {
  disabled?: boolean;
  inset?: boolean;
}

const { disabled = false, inset = false, class: className, ...props } = Astro.props;

const classes = cn(
  "relative flex w-full cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none transition-colors",
  "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground",
  "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
  "data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground",
  "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0",
  disabled && "pointer-events-none opacity-50",
  inset && "pl-8",
  className
);
---

<button
  type="button"
  class={classes}
  role="menuitem"
  disabled={disabled}
  tabindex="-1"
  data-context-menu-item
  data-context-menu-sub-trigger
  data-state="closed"
  aria-haspopup="menu"
  aria-expanded="false"
  {...props}
>
  <slot />
  <svg
    class="ml-auto size-4"
    aria-hidden="true"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
  >
    <polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"></polyline>
  </svg>
</button>
